info.title: EasyProject Web HTTP API
info.description: 真实HTTP接口；独立于既有MCP stdio/Tauri IPC。只描述契约与合成模型，不含真实凭据/业务记录。server/src为实现权威。

post.description: 12小时会话。Web返回HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Strict cookie且token=null；X-EasyProject-Client=desktop时返回内存Bearer。首次须改密码。30次/15分钟真实socket IP限流，反代后共享。禁止记录凭据或返回令牌。

post.summary: 执行账号工作区业务动作
post.description: 服务端按登录账号选择独立数据库，请求不能指定账号/路径。原生参数/返回复用DESKTOP_IPC.md与MODELS.md，不套用MCP默认值。严格model/action白名单：{"project":["add","create_from_template","get_all","update","delete"],"task":["add","get_all","swap_order","update","delete"],"member":["add","get_all","update","delete","search"],"project_member":["add","get_by_member","get_by_project","delete"],"task_dependency":["get_all","set_for_task"],"data":["export_json","import_json","backup","list_backups","preview_backup","restore"],"calendar":["fetch_ics"],"plan_baseline":["save","get_by_project","clear"]}。读返回data/revision；写须携带精确X-Workspace-Revision，旧值409且不写业务。写前UUID快照、持久失效旧epoch；传输中断先读回，禁止盲重试。JSON导入/恢复替换本账号全工作区，不是双向同步；远端不提供全库撤销。ICS沿用SSRF边界。

parameters.name: X-Workspace-Revision
parameters.description: 所有写动作必需；只读可省略，缺失或陈旧均409。
